project_name: Valdor Outfitter - LARP Gear & Quebec Adventurer Hub

header.style: Sticky at z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-stone-950/85 border-b border-stone-800/80 px-4 py-3 sm:px-6
elements: Brand Logo: 'Valdor Outfitter' with ember forge crest
Navigation links: Events (Montreal 3-4h), Shop (4 Cats), Build Look (Flow A), Character Oracle (Flow B)
Bilingual Switcher: FR / EN toggle button with subtle gold border
Cart Quick-Drawer Trigger with live count & price (CAD)

two_flow_cards.strategy: Two prominent side-by-side cards on desktop, stacked on mobile with equal prominence (50/50 split).

card_a.title_en: Flow A: Forge Your Own Look
card_a.description: Handpick individual armor, weapons, tent gear, and FX makeup with live CAD budget meter and selfie virtual try-on.

card_b.description: Answer 4 questions about your LARP persona (clan, combat archetype, camping comfort, budget) to generate a full lore-accurate kit.

events_finder.region: Montreal & 3-4h Radius (Estrie, Laurentides, Lanaudière, Montérégie, Mauricie, Ottawa/Outaouais)
features: AI Web Search refresh trigger with last-checked timestamp
Event metadata: Distance from Montreal (km & drive time), Rulebook/LARP System (Bicolline, Terres d'Arragon, etc.)
Direct link to official LARP organizer site
Filter by date, distance, and gear requirements

fields: City / Region selector (Montreal, Laval, Longueuil, Sherbrooke, Trois-Rivières, Gatineau, etc.)
Character Identity: Gender, Height (cm), Weight (kg) for gear sizing
Selfie photo upload for AI Virtual Fitting preview

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS and Radix/shadcn components. Do not generate TypeScript (.tsx) files.
Implement full bilingual toggling with an easy-to-read dictionary (fr/en) so every section supports Quebec francophone users and English participants.
Style surfaces with warm dark leathers (stone-900 to stone-950), ember borders (amber-500/30), parchment text (stone-200), and gold call-to-actions.
Never leave headers transparent. Keep sticky navigation legible over hero banners using backdrop-blur-xl bg-stone-950/85.
Add data-testid attributes to all major buttons, links, inputs, and interactive steps for robust automated verification.
Always provide realistic Montreal-radius LARP events (Duché de Bicolline in Saint-Mathieu-du-Parc, Terres de Bélénos, Terra Incognita, etc.) with verified-looking metadata and source links.
